species.note: South Africa's national fish - very shallow, rocky, surge-exposed water, boulder and kelp crevices. Extremely cautious; gives spearos only a brief window to shoot before it bolts.
Deeper rocky reef and kelp than galjoen or hottentot, territorial and cave-dwelling, retreating into crevices when threatened rather than fleeing outright.
Cape bream - abundant, shoaling, the most accessible reef fish here and a good species for newer divers. Calmer nearshore rocky and kelp water.

Seasonal warm-water gamefish, summer through early autumn, patrolling reef edges and kelp-bed margins rather than holding in one spot - one of the few places in South Africa it is regularly speared from shore.
